objective: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at the well in Tarren Mill and return to Brine in the Barrens.

description: Long ago I followed some companions into the Hillsbrad Foothills. We defended ourselves from some tenacious humans who make their home there and we found ourselves in a small town the Forsaken had taken over: Tarren Mill.

It was there I found a most peculiar thing: in the center of town was a small well of fresh spring water. I'm not sure the plagued citizens of the town even realize its value--it's a small holy vestige in an unhallowed sea.
Bring me a sample of that water in this waterskin.
progress: The well remaining pure within the town reminds me of stories told to me when I was younger, <name>. Even in times of great pain and sorrow one can find a sliver of hope, a small symbol to rally around. The orc people see Thrall this way. He survived against great odds and rose up to lead our people through his strength and example.
I'm not sure any orc has suffered as much as he has, but at the same time, I'm not sure any orc is as strong as he is either.
completion: This is good, <name>. You're dedicated to the task at hand and have the ability to seek out that which is needed.
One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Islen will be pleased as well.
